Requested items from Redwood’s side:
- POA (notarized or attested) uploaded into the DocuSign envelope or sent as a separate secure link.
- The signer verification step should include phone verification + a brief ID check (photo ID upload) before the countersign route opens.
- We need DocuSign to keep Connect/audit logs enabled and to provide the envelope ID & completion PDF once countersigned.

Operational plan I propose:
1) PayWise completes signer steps (Aaron) — you send final envelope ID.
2) We configure envelope routing so a manual reviewer (Ben Carter) is assigned the "Verify POA" role and will confirm the POA in DocuSign.
3) After Ben marks verified, our legal alias (legal@redwood.com) will countersign.

Karthik — looping you in for e-sign config and whether we should require ID upload in the envelope or accept the POA as a separate artifact. Ben — can you confirm availability tomorrow morning to do the verification?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Thanks for the context. A couple of e-sign configuration notes from infra/legal ops:

- Prefer ID upload as part of the envelope (DocuSign has a signer attachment role we can require). That reduces out-of-band POA email traffic and ensures the audit trail is contiguous.
- Routing suggestion: Signer (Aaron) -> Signer ID upload & POA attachment -> Internal verifier (Ben Carter) as "Manual Review" -> Legal alias countersign.
- For legacy signers we also recommend toggling the "Require signer phone authentication" option for extra confidence.
- If PayWise insists on the POA being external, please include a notarization page or apostille; we will accept notarized POA scanned in the envelope.

I attached a config snippet we apply for delegated signers. It lists the DocuSign role names and the order. If PayWise can name the signer role exactly (e.g., "PayWise - Authorized Signer") we can map it to our verifier rulematch.

Attachment: redwood_esign_config_snippet.txt (contains role names + order)

I will also check with infra to ensure DocuSign Connect is enabled for the envelope id once you share it; we can subscribe to completion webhooks and pull the signed PDF automatically.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
